From 27df68d579c67ef6c39a5047559b6a7c08c96219 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@somainline.org>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2021 19:37:24 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net/ipa: ipa_resource: Fix wrong for loop range

The source group count was mistakenly assigned to both dst and src loops.
Fix it to make IPA probe and work again.

Fixes: 4fd704b3608a ("net: ipa: record number of groups in data")
Acked-by: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@somainline.org>
Reviewed-by: Marijn Suijten <marijn.suijten@somainline.org>
Signed-off-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@somainline.org>
Reviewed-by: Alex Elder <elder@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20211111183724.593478-1-konrad.dybcio@somainline.org
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c b/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c
index e3da95d69409..06cec7199382 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c
@@ -52,7 +52,7 @@ static bool ipa_resource_limits_valid(struct ipa *ipa,
 				return false;
 	}
 
-	group_count = data->rsrc_group_src_count;
+	group_count = data->rsrc_group_dst_count;
 	if (!group_count || group_count > IPA_RESOURCE_GROUP_MAX)
 		return false;
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c`**
- The line that assigns the value to `group_count` has been modified. 
- The original code incorrectly assigned `data->rsrc_group_src_count` to `group_count`.
- The modified code correctly assigns `data->rsrc_group_dst_count` to `group_count`.

### Relationships
- The change addresses a bug where the source group count was mistakenly used for both source and destination loops, which could lead to incorrect behavior in the IPA probe functionality. 
- By fixing the assignment to use the destination group count, the patch ensures that the IPA resource management works as intended, thereby resolving the issue introduced in a previous commit (4fd704b3608a).

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
group_count = data->rsrc_group_src_count;
...
group_count = data->rsrc_group_src_count;
```
Reason:
The variable `group_count` was incorrectly assigned the value of `data->rsrc_group_src_count` for both source and destination resource limits. This mistake caused the validation logic to use the source group count when it should have been using the destination group count, leading to improper validation of resource limits and affecting the IPA probe functionality.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
group_count = data->rsrc_group_dst_count;
...
group_count = data->rsrc_group_dst_count;
```
Reason:
The fix changes the assignment of `group_count` to use `data->rsrc_group_dst_count` for the destination resource limits. This correction ensures that the validation logic correctly checks the limits for the destination resources, thereby restoring the proper functionality of the IPA probe.
